steps.title: Arm a track
steps.text: The round button in a track's header arms it for recording. Its Record menu chooses the input.

steps.title: Record
steps.text: Record starts the transport and the armed tracks capture. Record > Count-In and Pre-Roll starts it a bar or more early; Record Mode chooses overdub or replace.

steps.title: Takes
steps.text: Looped passes become take lanes, shown in the Inspector. Drag along a lane to comp that range; double-click to cycle the take there.

steps.title: The launcher
steps.text: Cells play patterns and samples in time. With Keep Listening on, Launcher > Record What I Played Into a Cell keeps what you just played as a new pattern.
